messages:
eve: Anyone hit the node quickstart getting stuck in a token-refresh loop after the first successful call?
I run the sample-app, first generate returns 200, then every subsequent call returns 401/403. Logs spam `refresh_token failed: 401` and `retrying` forever. Workspace is a new org — wondering if billing gating is involved. @devex-bot any quick pointers?

alex: hm. can you paste how you started it and which key you set (REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY)? also which sdk version?

eve: Using node SDK v0.8.1, set REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY with the service-account JSON (mounted in container). start command: `npm run start:quickstart` from sample-node repo. Relevant tail of logs:

```
[info] first call ok
[error] token refresh failed: 401
[warn] retrying in 500ms
[info] calling generate...
```

sam: that pattern smells like billing gating — first call maybe goes through then subsequent auth checks fail once the workspace state is probed. can you run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami` and paste output (redact tokens)?

eve: ran it, response includes `workspace_id: w_12345` and `billing_state: payment_required` — so yeah looks gated.

alex: ok that explains it. there's a known bug in node sdk <=0.8.1 where a 401 during token refresh is treated as retryable and the refresh middleware loops instead of surfacing a clear billing error. two actionable options:
- quick fix: set a workspace-scoped API key in `REDWOOD_API_KEY` instead of service-account refresh flow, or
- upgrade to SDK >=0.8.3 which short-circuits on refresh 401 and surfaces `billing_required` error.

also as a temporary mitigation you can configure the client to cap retries: `new Redwood({ retry: { maxRetries: 1 } })` so it won't loop forever.

eve: upgrading to 0.8.3 fixed it locally — now the sample exits with a clear `billing required` message instead of hanging. thanks. we'll use a workspace API key for the sandbox until billing is sorted.

alex: great. filing a quick task to add a startup check in quickstart that calls whoami and warns if `billing_state != active`, and update README to mention this case.

devex-bot: Created DEVEX-421: "quickstart: node sample hangs on token-refresh when workspace billing gated" assigned to alex. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-421 :thumbsup:

eve: awesome — one more thing: could we add a short troubleshooting blurb in the console output when sample detects `payment_required` (like `Detected billing_required — see docs at <link>`)? users kept reopening threads for this.

alex: yep will add that and a tiny note in the onboarding checklist. will push PR with tests + docs by EOD.

eve: thanks! saved my afternoon :)
